QF.id: VIII Introduction to Clearing and Settlement System_8

question.text: Which of the following has the highest net worth requirement among clearing member categories?

answer.text: All clearing members have the same net worth requirement

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI prescribes a net worth of Rs. 3 crores for clearing members (PCMs) and Rs. 1 crore for self-clearing members (SCMs). A trading member has no SEBI-specified net worth requirement, since a TM only trades and does not clear. Among the options listed, the PCM therefore carries the highest net worth requirement. The Trap: A trading member only places orders and does not face SEBI's clearing-member net worth rule, so it is not the highest. SCM is set at Rs. 1 crore, which is below the Rs. 3 crore requirement for clearing members. Note: Workbook figures: clearing member Rs. 3 crores, self-clearing member Rs. 1 crore, trading member no SEBI-specified net worth.
